title: Tyler on several 1940s crashes in New Mexico

tellings.quote: it was a secret place uh on government land it was a New Mexico crash retrieval place and it was a place that you know was not Roswell but this is what Tyler told me he said there were a few crashes that happened in the 1940s

plain: Several craft are said to have crashed in New Mexico in the 1940s and been taken to a secret crash-retrieval site on government land that was not Roswell. The religion scholar Diana Pasulka tells Michels this is what a man she calls Tyler told her. If true, Roswell would have been one of several such crashes rather than a single event.
